remarks: This contemporary home offers 3 bedrooms and 2.5 bathrooms with vaulted ceilings and an open floor plan filled with natural light. The primary suite includes a fireplace and patio access, while a second fireplace anchors the main living area. The kitchen features granite countertops and a functional design suitable for daily living and entertaining. A 500 sq. ft. garage provides ample storage. Outdoor patios off the living room and primary suite offer mountain views, all within a private, walled property featuring low-maintenance landscaping and no HOA.
